title: aider_shim's proofs read aider's source the same on every box
intention: aider_shim's proofs that read aider's own source read the same on every box that runs them.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_fence.py reds test_the_record_survives_the_handler_that_aider_actually_has and test_the_refusal_escapes_every_handler_on_aiders_actual_call_path; test_translation.py reds test_a_holding_OUTSIDE_the_repo_is_never_editable and test_the_briefs_fields_are_the_names_aiders_Coder_ACTUALLY_takes. All four read ~/dev/src/aider (aider/models.py, aider/coders/base_coder.py), absent on this box.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box); outline 13.3.1.
how: Per open-4abe1b0b6383: (a) every box: the bootstrap installs ~/dev/src/aider and the proofs stay as written; (b) only the aider box: the four teeth read aider's source where it stands and otherwise judge a measured record of the call shapes they read, which any live source must agree with.

clauses.claim: each of the four teeth reds when the shim's adaptation it judges is hollowed

decisions.text: D1: the four teeth read the same on every box, by the branch open-4abe1b0b6383 names.

measured.saw: test_fence.py RED 2 failures; test_translation.py RED 2 failures; ls ~/dev/src/aider: no such directory
measured.how: bin/cairn test over cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs on akienasus
